headline: DPSC Limited files Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; SEBI PIT disclosure filed
sum: DPSC Limited has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), filing the mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 7(2) with NSE on 26 June 2026.
detail: DPSC Limited has formally disclosed to NSE the commencement of its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, a statutory procedure under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 7(2) read with Regulation 6(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, mandating continuous disclosure of material events to stock exchanges. The timing and substance of the filing indicate the company has been admitted to CIRP proceedings, triggering mandatory trading restrictions and stakeholder notification requirements.
